description: Weekly dependency updates, one grouped pull request per ecosystem. Every pull request carries `technical`, its area and `no-changelog` (the household sees none of it, .claude/CLAUDE.md) and runs the whole of ci.yml before it is merged.

packageRules.description: Claude Desktop's extension (#309): its bridge, vendored into the image, and the version the manual setup of the Sécurité page pins (web/src/features/security/mcpSnippets.ts), bumped together.

Nid's own images are published on every merge to main: a pinned digest would freeze the standalone compose on an old release, one that may lack what its README describes (issue 215). They follow `latest` unpinned.
openapi-typescript and typescript-eslint use the TypeScript JS API, which TypeScript 7 no longer has; the type check already runs TypeScript 7 as typescript-native. Lift once both support it.

A Postgres major cannot read the previous major's data: it needs pg_upgrade or a dump and restore of the household's database, and the image's volume path changes with 18. Done by hand, with that migration.

customManagers.description: The mcp-remote version the manual Claude Desktop setup names (#309).
